description: มุน 2026-07-29 (calendar Phase 7, FINAL of the set): the notifications screen shipped in Phase 6 was UNREACHABLE (no surface linked to it — my completeness lens ran spatial/state-space/reference-parity but never reachability). Phase 7 adds 2 entry-points (A1: DayHeader bell → /v2/calendar/notifications, was a static Mate AI glyph; A2: post-save 'ดูรายการทั้งหมด' button on the day page) and walks the whole journey. goo's hooks untouched. Bug-class the anchor owns: DEAD-END / ORPHAN-SCREEN + cross-screen menu-state — a screen can be pixel-perfect and functional yet have no way in (reachability, the ฟีม-ratified 4th completeness axis, first live use) or a wrong bottom-menu state, and no per-screen anchor catches a JOURNEY defect. run-calendar-flow.ts walks /v2 → month → day → advanced-toggle → sheet → save → list → cancel → back and asserts: no-overflow-x @393/360/320 on every screen; no dead-end (every non-month screen has a way back to /v2/calendar); menu state per screen (month=1 tabs, day-unsaved=2 primary-cta, sheet-open=4 form/no-MateAI, saved=3); A1 bell + A2 button are REAL inbound links to notifications (reachability proven by comprehensive grep href+import+push — a literal-href grep gives false positives on array/router.push-driven nav, บอง's lesson); WITHIN-page state continuity (save→reminder-count 0→1 on the day page; cancel→row AND summary both 3→2 on the list); 0 app-fetch + 0 console across the walk; and all 5 prior anchors (month/day/advanced/save/notifications) re-run green (done-condition 5 — Phase 7 touches DayHeader+[date], if a screen breaks only the anchor tells). SCOPE: cross-page reminder PERSISTENCE is an intentional mock limitation, not a bug — useReminders is per-page useState(MOCK), so a save on day X doesn't appear on the notifications page; at API-time useReminders fetches from server so every mounted page gets the same data → continuity emerges for free without a shared store (adding context now = code torn out at API-time = scope creep; บอง-decided). Also enumerated OTHER orphans (axis-4 'is there another unreachable screen?'): /v2/home-preview + /v2/menu-preview = dev previews (intentional); /v2/onboarding route has no inbound link but its component renders via /v2 (anon useV2AuthGate) = redundant/vestigial route → flagged to บอง→ฟีม, not touched. Teeth mut-orphan-notifications (remove the bell or A2) → entry-point checks fail → CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual/flow-reachability+menu-state. ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-calendar-flow.ts#mut-orphan-notifications
